+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+DATA = "data/crashes.parquet"
+OUT = Path("out")
+con = duckdb.connect()
+year_rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS yr, min(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           max(crash_date) AS last_date, count(*) AS rows
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+    WHERE crash_date IS NOT NULL
+    GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
+    """
+).fetchall()
+if not year_rows:
+    raise RuntimeError("No dated crash rows found")
+
+first_year, last_year = year_rows[0][0], year_rows[-1][0]
+partial_years = []
+for yr, first_date, last_date, _ in year_rows:
+    partial = (yr == first_year and (first_date.month, first_date.day) > (1, 1))
+    partial = partial or (yr == last_year and (last_date.month, last_date.day) < (12, 31))
+    if partial:
+        partial_years.append(yr)
+complete_years = [row[0] for row in year_rows if row[0] not in partial_years]
+if not complete_years:
+    raise RuntimeError("No complete calendar years identified")
+
+years_sql = ",".join(str(y) for y in complete_years)
+base_rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS yr, count(*) AS population_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_time IS NULL) AS missing_time,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_time = TIME '00:00:00') AS midnight_time,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_persons_injured IS NULL) AS missing_injured,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_persons_killed IS NULL) AS missing_killed,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+                            AND number_of_persons_injured IS NOT NULL
+                            AND number_of_persons_killed IS NOT NULL) AS eligible_rows
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+    WHERE crash_date IS NOT NULL AND year(crash_date) IN ({years_sql})
+    GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
+    """
+).fetchall()
+undated = con.execute(
+    f"SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet('{DATA}') WHERE crash_date IS NULL"
+).fetchone()[0]
+time_type = con.execute(
+    f"DESCRIBE SELECT crash_time FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')"
+).fetchone()[1]
+
+facts = [
+    ("file_year_coverage", "; ".join(
+        f"{yr}: {first_date} through {last_date} ({rows:,} dated rows)"
+        for yr, first_date, last_date, rows in year_rows
+    )),
+    ("partial_calendar_years_excluded", ", ".join(map(str, partial_years)) or "none"),
+    ("complete_calendar_years_used", ", ".join(map(str, complete_years))),
+    ("rows_with_missing_crash_date_unassignable_to_year", f"{undated:,}"),
+    ("population_rows_in_complete_years", f"{sum(r[1] for r in base_rows):,}"),
+    ("crash_time_storage_type", time_type),
+    ("crash_time_impossible_or_blank_values", "0; TIME typed column cannot store blank, unknown-word, or out-of-range clock values"),
+    ("number_of_persons_injured_impossible_value_check", "not checked by value; this field is assessed only for missingness in the data check"),
+    ("number_of_persons_killed_impossible_value_check", "not checked by value; this field is assessed only for missingness in the data check"),
+]
+for yr, first_date, last_date, rows in year_rows:
+    facts.append((f"coverage_{yr}", f"{first_date} through {last_date}; {'partial boundary year excluded' if yr in partial_years else 'included'}"))
+for yr, pop, missing_time, midnight, missing_injured, missing_killed, eligible in base_rows:
+    facts.extend([
+        (f"year_{yr}_population_rows", f"{pop:,}"),
+        (f"year_{yr}_missing_crash_time_rows", f"{missing_time:,}"),
+        (f"year_{yr}_midnight_time_rows_kept_in_night", f"{midnight:,}"),
+        (f"year_{yr}_missing_number_of_persons_injured_rows", f"{missing_injured:,}"),
+        (f"year_{yr}_missing_number_of_persons_killed_rows", f"{missing_killed:,}"),
+        (f"year_{yr}_eligible_rows_after_missing_field_filters", f"{eligible:,}"),
+    ])
+if len(base_rows) > 1:
+    changes = []
+    for previous, current in zip(base_rows, base_rows[1:]):
+        delta = current[-1] - previous[-1]
+        changes.append((abs(delta), previous[0], current[0], delta))
+    _, y1, y2, delta = max(changes)
+    facts.append(("largest_neighboring_year_change_in_eligible_rows", f"{y1} to {y2}: {delta:+,} rows (absolute change {abs(delta):,})"))
+else:
+    facts.append(("largest_neighboring_year_change_in_eligible_rows", "not applicable; fewer than two complete years"))
+
+for option_id in (1, 2):
+    with (OUT / f"check_{option_id}.csv").open("w", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writerows(facts)
*** End Patch

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+con = duckdb.connect()
+base = """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           CASE WHEN crash_time = TIME '00:00:00' THEN 'Midnight / possible default'
+                WHEN crash_time < TIME '06:00:00' OR crash_time >= TIME '20:00:00' THEN 'Night'
+                ELSE 'Day' END AS time_group,
+           number_of_persons_injured AS injured,
+           number_of_persons_killed AS killed
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025
+      AND crash_time IS NOT NULL
+      AND number_of_persons_injured IS NOT NULL
+      AND number_of_persons_killed IS NOT NULL
+"""
+
+injury_share = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year, time_group,
+           count(*) AS eligible_crashes,
+           sum(CASE WHEN injured + killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crashes_with_injury_or_death,
+           100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN injured + killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS injury_or_death_crash_share_pct
+    FROM ({base})
+    GROUP BY year, time_group
+    ORDER BY year, CASE time_group WHEN 'Day' THEN 1 WHEN 'Night' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+injury_share.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+casualty_rate = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year, time_group,
+           count(*) AS eligible_crashes,
+           sum(injured) AS persons_injured,
+           sum(killed) AS persons_killed,
+           sum(injured + killed) AS injured_plus_killed_people,
+           100.0 * sum(injured + killed) / count(*) AS injured_plus_killed_per_100_crashes
+    FROM ({base})
+    GROUP BY year, time_group
+    ORDER BY year, CASE time_group WHEN 'Day' THEN 1 WHEN 'Night' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+casualty_rate.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+colors = {"Day": "#2471A3", "Night": "#C0392B", "Midnight / possible default": "#777777"}
+styles = {"Day": "-", "Night": "-", "Midnight / possible default": "--"}
+
+
+def draw_chart(data, y_column, ylabel, title, subtitle, output, y_format):
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6.8))
+    for group in ("Day", "Night", "Midnight / possible default"):
+        part = data[data["time_group"] == group]
+        ax.plot(
+            part["year"], part[y_column], marker="o", markersize=4.5,
+            linewidth=2, linestyle=styles[group], color=colors[group], label=group,
+        )
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=15, weight="bold", pad=26)
+    ax.text(0, 1.015, subtitle, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9.5, color="#444444", va="bottom")
+    ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year")
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
+    ax.set_xticks(sorted(data["year"].unique()))
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(y_format)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+    ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=3, loc="upper left")
+    fig.tight_layout()
+    fig.savefig(OUT / output, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+
+from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter
+
+draw_chart(
+    injury_share, "injury_or_death_crash_share_pct", "Crashes with injury or death (%)",
+    "Injury-or-death crashes among NYC police-reported crashes, 2013–2025",
+    "Eligible crashes with known person-injury and death counts; night = 20:00–05:59 except 00:00, day = 06:00–19:59. Midnight isolated as possible default; not a per-trip risk measure.",
+    "option_1.png", FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value:.0f}%"),
+)
+draw_chart(
+    casualty_rate, "injured_plus_killed_per_100_crashes", "Injured + killed people per 100 crashes",
+    "Injured and killed people per 100 NYC police-reported crashes, 2013–2025",
+    "Eligible crashes with known person-injury and death counts; night = 20:00–05:59 except 00:00, day = 06:00–19:59. Midnight isolated as possible default; no traffic-exposure denominator.",
+    "option_2.png", FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value:.1f}"),
+)
